content: Oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃ. Hūṃ hūṃ, avert, avert the mind-training!Daughter of gossip, flesh-eater!Daughter of gossip, blood-drinker!Daughter of gossip, chatterer!Daughter of gossip, red-eyed one!Daughter of gossip, red-nosed one!You know all that is not to be known!You go everywhere you are not to go!You cause all illnesses that are not to be caused!You speak all that is not to be spoken!Daughter of gossip, listen here!Dark one, bitter one, long-headed one!Where did you first come from?At first, I came from the border of China and Tibet.Many rumors were planted in China.The King of China transformed Tibet.Many Chinese demons have returned to the community.In the land known as Yarlung,Because ill-omened gossip has been planted,There is talk of horse disease among the horses.There is talk of human disease among the people.The young girl is harmed by epidemic fever.This is the result of encountering you, Gossip.Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy.I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.On the path where you, Gossip, come,You have encountered the snow lion of the high peaks.From the mouth of Gossip, these words are spoken:"How happy the lioness and her cub,Displaying their turquoise manes and roaming the high snows."Then, after three days had passed,The snow lion and her cub were buried by snow.This is the result of encountering you, Gossip.Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy.I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.On the path where you, Gossip, come,You have encountered the deer of the high meadows.From the mouth of the daughter of Gossip, these words are spoken:"How happy the deer and her fawn,Displaying their antler tips and roaming the high meadows."Then, after three days had passed,The deer and her fawn were killed by the lynx.This is the result of encountering you, Gossip.Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy.I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.On the path where you, Gossip, come,You have encountered the wild bird of the high crags.From the mouth of Gossip, these words are spoken:"How happy the wild white vulture,Displaying its primary feathers and roaming the high crags."Then, after three days had passed,The wild white vulture fell into the abyss.This is the result of encountering you, Gossip.Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy.I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.On the path where you, Gossip, come,You have encountered the thrush of the willow grove.From the mouth of Gossip, these words are spoken:"How happy the thrush and her brood,Displaying their melodious song and circling the willow grove."Then, after three days had passed,The thrush was killed by the predatory hawk.This is the result of encountering you, Gossip.Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy.I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.On the path where you, Gossip, come,You have encountered the fish of the upper lake.From the mouth of the daughter of Gossip, these words are spoken:"How happy the fish and her brood,Displaying their golden eyes and circling the edge of the lake."Then, after three days had passed,The fish was caught by the hook of the dol.This is the result of encountering you, Gossip.Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy.I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.That is merely the way Gossip comes.Then, as for the way Gossip manifests:Sometimes it stays on the mountain peak,Saying, "I am the king of mountains, Mount Meru."Sometimes it stays by the shore of the ocean,Saying, "I am the king of the lake spirits."Sometimes it stays in the space between,Saying, "I am the eight classes of gods and demons."Sometimes it stays at the Red Rock gorge,Saying, "I am the protector of the Red Rock gorge."Sometimes it stays on the peak of the castle,Saying, "I am the male deity of the heights."Sometimes it stays in the depths of the house,Saying, "I am the household deity of the home."Sometimes it stays in the depths of the treasury,Saying, "I am the treasury deity of the storehouse."May the three brothers of the treasury deity arise,Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy,And I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.Sometimes it stays in the depths of the hearth,Saying, "I am the hearth deity of the stove."May the three brothers of the hearth deity arise,Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy,And I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.Sometimes it stays on the peak of the ladder,Saying, "I am the ladder deity of the stairs."May the long-lineage ladder deity arise,Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy,And I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.Sometimes it stays in the depths of the enclosure,Saying, "I am the livestock deity of the animals."May the three brothers of the livestock deity arise,Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy,And I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.Sometimes it stays behind the door,Saying, "I am the door deity of the entrance."May the Four Great Kings arise,Turn this ill-omened gossip toward the enemy,And I pray, avert the black water of misfortune.This too is a manifestation of gossip.First, at glorious Samyé,In the royal palace of the central pinnacle,Upon King Khri srong lde'u btsan,The gossip of all the black-headed people was fixed.Upon the Prince Mutri Tsenpo,The gossip of all householders was fixed.Upon the Master Padmasambhava,The gossip of all gods and demons was fixed.Upon the Abbot Bodhisattva,The gossip of all monastics was fixed.Upon the Great Translator Vairocana,The gossip of all translators was fixed.Upon the bhikṣu Namkhai Nyingpo,The gossip of all religious practitioners was fixed.Upon Nanam Dorje Dudjom,The gossip of all mantra-holders was fixed.Upon the queen Margyen,The gossip of all women was fixed.Upon the patron and benefactor,The gossip of all wandering beings was fixed.Upon all the Tibetan subjects, gods and humans,The gossip of the entire kingdom was fixed.The gossip of humans with form was fixed,The gossip of gods and demons without form was fixed.If it exists, the gossip of what exists was fixed,If it does not exist, the gossip of what does not exist was fixed.Listen here, maiden of gossip!You are first the nine siblings of the rgya-dre demons,In the middle, the nine siblings of the demonesses,And finally, the nine siblings of gossip.Though you are transformed, turn back; though you are turned back, depart!You have no place to stay here.Do not remain, gossip; go away, gossip!The path of gossip is shown to you, it lies to the east.Once you have gone away from here,There is a place where the one plain gathers out and gathers in.There is a maṇḍala where the three plains gather.It is the gathering place for the the'u-rang children.Do not stay there; go away!Once you have gone away from there,There is a place where that mountain gathers out and gathers in.There is a maṇḍala where the three lineages gather.It is the gathering place for male and female living ghosts.Do not stay there; go away!Once you have gone away from there,There is a place where that water gathers out and gathers in.From the maṇḍala where the three waters gather,It is the gathering place for male and female water ghosts.Do not stay there; go away!Once you have gone away from here,In the eastern direction, in the land called Kong-yul,The gossip is being directed toward the gods.The gossip is being directed toward the klu.Ill omens are being summoned as prosperity.You have no place to remain amidst this gossip.Do not remain in the gossip; go away from the gossip.Go to the place where it is directed toward the gods.Go to the place where it is directed toward the klu.Go to the place where it is summoned as prosperity.You, do not remain in the gossip; go away from the gossip.The girl of the gossip says this:"Great Master, please listen to me.Padmasambhava, please listen to me.""As I do not remain in the gossip and must go,I need a form that can go into the gossip."The Great Master spoke these words:You, girl of the gossip, listen here!If there is no form for the gossip to go in,A hollow straw is the form of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the form of the gossip.If the body of the gossip has no head,A red clay pot is the head of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the head of the gossip.If the head of the gossip has no brain,A buzzing fly is the brain of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the brain of the gossip.If the head of the gossip has no hair,A black pig’s bristle is the hair of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the hair of the gossip.If there is no ear to listen to the gossip,Idle chatter and gossip are the ears of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the ears of the gossip.If the gossip has no eye to see,A small black bean is the eye of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the eye of the gossip.If the gossip has no nose to smell,A red clay handle is the nose of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the nose of the gossip.If the gossip has no mouth to open,A pungent seed is the mouth of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the mouth of the gossip.If the gossip has no teeth to eat,A hollow cowrie shell is the tooth of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the tooth of the gossip.If the gossip has no tongue to speak,A small red flax seed is the tongue of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the tongue of the gossip.If the gossip has no heart to think,A three-cornered buckwheat is the heart of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the heart of the gossip.If the gossip has no hand to reach,A sensory organ is the hand of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the hand of the gossip.If the gossip has no clothes to wear,A black net is the garment of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the garment of the gossip.If the gossip has no waist to bind,A mule-tether loop is the waist of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the waist of the gossip.If the gossip has no foot to plant,A goat’s life or a sheep’s life is the foot of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the foot of the gossip.If the gossip has no shoes to wear,A hoof of Kharak is the shoe of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the shoe of the gossip.If the gossip has no hat for its head,A goat-ear or sheep-ear is the hat of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the hat of the gossip.If the gossip has no horse to ride,A black or white wild ass is the horse of the gossip.Go, accompanied by the horse of the gossip.If the gossip has no sword to wield,A tempered iron sword is the sword of the gossip.A red copper sword is the sword of the gossip.A blunt wooden sword is the sword of the gossip.Gossip, you go, accompanied by the sword.If the gossip has no bow and arrow,A barberry-wood arrow and barberry-wood bow are the bow of the gossip.A spindle-tree arrow and spindle-tree bow are the arrow of the gossip.Gossip, you go, accompanied by the bow and arrow.If the gossip has no food to eat,Wild vegetables are the food of the gossip.Garlic, onion, and radish are the food of the gossip.Breakfast and light snacks are the food of the gossip.Eaten meat and bones are the food of the gossip.Dregs from drinking beer are the food of the gossip.Tea dregs and leftovers are the food of the gossip.Salt, soda, and butter are the food of the gossip.Leftover food and drink are the food of the gossip.The dregs of what is drunk are the food of the gossip.Gossip, you go, accompanied by the food.If the gossip has no accumulated wealth,Broken ladles and broken bowls are the wealth of the gossip.Gold, silver, copper, and iron are the wealth of the gossip.Varieties of silk and cloth are the wealth of the gossip.Various kinds of grain are the wealth of the gossip.White and red wool and dye are the wealth of the gossip.Gossip, you go, accompanied by the wealth.If the gossip has no fortress to rely upon,A yak-horn ladle is the fortress of the gossip.The sky and a distant banner are the fortress of the gossip.Gossip, you go, accompanied by the fortress.If the gossip has no path to travel upon,Root-paths and water-paths are the paths of the gossip.Dusty paths and trails are the paths of the gossip.Ghost-paths and crooked ways are the paths of the gossip.Dark demon-paths are the paths of the gossip.Gossip, you go, accompanied by the path.Of the patron, the people, the wealth, and the retinue,Take the scapegoats and the calamities and go.Gossip, daughter, do not stay; go.Of these masters of generosity,From the top of the fortress above,Down to the threshold below,In one year of twelve months,There are three hundred and sixty days.Carry away the sickness of the body and go.Carry away the suffering of the mind and go.Carry away the mouthfuls of food and water and go.Carry away the obstacles and sudden circumstances and go.Carry away the demon of the master and go.Carry away the calamities of faults and go.Carry away the basis for gossip and go.Gossip, do not stay; gossip, go.Do not be attached to the constructed fortress.Do not be attached to the people above.Do not be attached to the livestock below.Do not be attached to the dog at the door.Do not be attached to the male.Do not be attached to the female.Do not be attached to the small child.Do not harm the field that has been sown.Do not be attached to the white curd.Do not be attached to the brewed beer.Do not be attached to gold and silver.Do not be attached to the blue turquoise.Do not be attached to the white barley.Do not be attached to the adorned clothing.Do not be attached to the horse you ride.Do not be attached to the small brown mule.Do not be attached to the white-spotted dzo.Do not be attached to the wish-granting cow.Do not be attached to the speckled female yak.Do not be attached to the white-fleeced sheep.Do not be attached to this life.Do not be attached to iron and copper.Avert the gossip of the many hundreds.Avert the scrutiny of the many thousands.Avert the talk of the people of the realm.Do not dwell on gossip; let the gossip go.Bhoḥ bhyo, avert, avert!
